The Emperor said: The Huns violated the laws of nature, violated human relations, bullied their elders, abused the elderly, took theft as a profession, defrauded barbarians, plotted conspiracies, relied on force, and repeatedly invaded the borders. Therefore, the imperial court sent troops and generals to combat their crimes. Didn't the "Book of Songs" say, "I attacked the enemy and reached Taiyuan; the chariots rumbled and built a city in the north." Now the cavalry general Wei Qing crossed the Xihe River to Gaoque, annihilated 2,300 enemy troops, captured their supplies and animals as spoils of war, and was granted the title of lord. Then he marched westward to pacify the Henan area, patrolled the old fortress of Yuxi, crossed Ziling, built a bridge over the Beihe River, leveled Puni, defeated Fuli, killed the elite enemy soldiers, and captured 3,017 soldiers who were hiding in ambushes. Capture and question the prisoners, know where the enemy is, capture all the soldiers, drive back more than a million horses, cattle and sheep, and return the entire army. An additional 3,800 households were granted the title of Wei Qing Shiyi. After that, the Xiongnu invaded Daijun, Yanmen, Dingxiang, Shangjun, and Shuofang in successive years, killing and plundering many people. The incident is recorded in "The Biography of the Huns". In the spring of the fifth year of Yuan Shuo, the Han Dynasty ordered the cavalry general Wei Qing to lead 30,000 cavalry out of Gaoque. Wei Wei Su Jian served as the guerrilla general, Zuo Nei Shi Li Ju served as the strong crossbow general, Tai servant Gong Sun He served as the cavalry general, and acting Prime Minister Li Cai served as the light chariot general. They were all under the control of the cavalry generals and sent troops to Shuofang. Daxing ordered Li Xi and Antou Hou Zhang Cigong to serve as generals, and they both sent troops to Beiping County. King Youxian of the Xiongnu faced Wei Qing and other troops, thinking that the Han army could not reach him, so he got drunk. Han soldiers arrived at night and surrounded King Youxian. King Youxian was frightened and fled overnight. He took only one of his concubines and hundreds of strong cavalry and fled northward through the Han army's encirclement. The Han Dynasty Qingqi Colonel Guo Cheng and others chased for hundreds of miles, but failed to catch up. They captured more than ten people under King Youxian, more than 15,000 men and women, and tens of millions of livestock. So Wei Qing led his army back. When the army arrived at the frontier, the emperor sent an envoy to hold the seal of the general, and appointed Wei Qing, the general of chariots and cavalry, as the general in the army. All the generals put their troops under the command of the general, and the general established his official title and returned. The Emperor said: General Wei Qing personally led his soldiers in the battle and achieved a great victory. He captured more than ten Xiongnu kings and granted 8,700 additional households in Wei Qing's food town. He also granted Wei Qing's sons Wei and his wife the title of Marquis of Yichun, Wei Busuo as the Marquis of Yin'an, and Wei Deng as the Marquis of Fagan. Wei Qing resolutely refused and said: I am fortunate to be able to serve in the army. Relying on His Majesty's divine power, our army's great victory is all due to the hard work of all the captains.

In the second year of Emperor Gaozu's reign, he was made the crown prince. In April of the twelfth year of Emperor Gaozu's reign, Emperor Gaozu passed away. On May 17, the prince became the emperor, and his mother, Empress Lu, became the empress dowager. Reward subjects with first-level titles. Zhonglang and Langzhong officials who have served for six years will be promoted to the third level, and those who have served for four years will be promoted to the second level. A second-level wailang officer who has served for six years. The middle man who has been in office for less than one year will be promoted to a higher level, and the outer man who has been in office for less than two years will be rewarded with a reward of 10,000 yuan. The eunuch's salary is the same as that of a doctor. The salaries of the emperor's attendants such as the eunuchs, bearers, halberds, warriors, and cavalrymen were the same as those of the foreign ministers. The prince's imperial concubine was rewarded with the title of fifth doctor, and those who served for five years would be given the title of second grade. Those who organize the funeral for the great ancestor will be rewarded with a reward of 20,000 yuan for those with a salary of 2,000 shi, a reward of 10,000 for those with a salary of 600 shi or more, and a reward of 5,000 for those with a salary of less than 500 shi. Those who build a mausoleum for the great ancestor will be rewarded 40 gold by the general, 20 gold for 2,000 shi, 6 gold for more than 600 shi, and 2 gold for less than 500 shi. Reduce land rent and restore the system of one tax for every fifteen people. Those who have a rank of five officials, more than six hundred shi, and those who have served the emperor and whose names are known to the emperor, and who commit crimes and should be yoke and chained, can be relaxed to house arrest instead of being thrown into prison. For those with official positions above Shangzao, grandsons inside and outside the royal family, or children and grandchildren who are no longer related by blood, etc., those who commit crimes should be punished, or if they should be sentenced to four years in prison, the sentence should be reduced to three years. People over seventy and under ten who are guilty and should be punished are exempted from corporal punishment. The emperor also pointed out in the order: The duty of officials is to do things for the people. If they work hard to do things well, they will gain the trust of the people. The reason why they are improved is to ask them to do things better for the people. All officials whose salary is more than 600 dan, who live with their parents and wives, and those who have worn the seal of general or captain who are no longer in office and have served in the army, or who have worn the official seal of 2,000 dan, only need to pay military tax and are exempt from all other corvee services. The princes and princes of each county were ordered to build the ancestral temple of Gaozu. In the winter of December of the first year of Emperor Hui, King Liu Ruyi of Zhao Yin passed away. It is stipulated that if a subject commits a crime, he can atone for the crime of death by paying the money of the 30th level. Reward the common people with titles, one level for each household. In the first month of spring, the city of Chang'an was built.

source: Empress Gao, the Lu family, gave birth to Emperor Hui, who assisted Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty to pacify the world. Her father and brother had three marquises under Emperor Gaozu. After Emperor Hui succeeded to the throne, he honored Empress Lu as the Queen Mother. The Queen Mother made the daughter of Princess Lu Yuan, the sister of Emperor Hui, the Queen. She had no children, so she made the son of a beauty in the harem the Prince. Emperor Hui died, and the prince was established as emperor. The emperor was young, and Empress Dowager Lu came to the court to perform the emperor's affairs and grant amnesty to the world. Later, four of his brother's sons, Lu Tai, Lu Chan, Lu Lu, and Lu Tai's son Lu Tong were made kings, and six Zhu Lu were made princes. The specific details can be found in "Book of Han·Biography of Wai Qi". In the first month of the spring of the first year of Empress Lu's reign, she issued an edict saying: It turned out that Emperor Xiaohui intended to abolish the harsh laws that punished serious crimes and three clans, and regarded wrong words as evil words. He died before the resolution was resolved. It has now been announced that it will be abolished. In February, the people were rewarded with titles of nobility, one level for each household. For the first time, an official with an annual salary of two thousand shi was set up to encourage the world's filial piety. On the fourth day of May in the summer, a fire broke out in the Congtai of Zhao Palace. Liu Qiang, the son of Emperor Xiaohui's harem, was made the King of Huaiyang, Liu Buyi was the King of Hengshan, Liu Hong was the Marquis of Xiangcheng, Liu Chao was the Marquis of Zhi, and Liu Wu was the Marquis of Huguan. In autumn, peaches and plums bloom. In the spring of the second year of Empress Lu's reign, she issued an edict saying: Emperor Gao unified the world and granted fiefs and feudal lordships to all the meritorious officials. All the people were safe and sound, and no one was immune from his kindness. I consider that in the future, due to the passage of time, no one will remember his fame and honor, and will not be able to respect his great righteousness and pass it on to future generations. Now I want to rank the status of each prince in the court according to the size of his merits. I will hide the merit book in the ancestral temple of Emperor Gao and pass it down from generation to generation. His descendants will inherit their merits and titles hereditary. Please work with the princes to submit a proposal. Prime Minister Chen Ping reported: I have discussed with Jianghou Zhoubo, Quzhouhou Lishang, Yinhou Guanying, Anguohou Wang Ling, etc., that the princes were favored and were rewarded with rents and food. Your Majesty also extended extra favors and assigned grades based on merit. Please keep the merit book in the high temple. Empress Lu approved this memorial. On the 27th of the first lunar month of spring, an earthquake occurred and a landslide occurred in Wudu Road. On June 30th in summer, there was a partial solar eclipse. In the seventh month of autumn, Liu Buyi, the king of Hengshan, passed away and eight baht coins were used again. In the summer of the third year of Empress Lu's reign, the Yangtze River and the Han River overflowed, flooding more than 4,000 houses. In autumn, stars appear during the day. In the summer of the fourth year of Empress Lu's reign, the young emperor secretly knew that he was not the empress's biological child, so he complained. The Empress Dowager put him under house arrest in a long alley.
gold_target: Empress Gao, of the Lu family, was the mother of Emperor Hui and assisted Emperor Gaozu in pacifying the realm. After Emperor Hui ascended, she became the Queen Mother. She arranged for her granddaughter, the daughter of Princess Lu Yuan, to be the Queen, who had no children, so a son from a harem beauty was made prince. Upon Emperor Hui's death, this prince became emperor, but due to his youth, Empress Dowager Lu ruled in his stead, granting amnesty and promoting her relatives: four of her brother's sons were made kings, and six others were made princes. In the first year of her reign, she abolished harsh laws and rewarded the people. She established officials to encourage filial piety. In the second year, she ordered merit rankings for princes to be preserved in the ancestral temple. Natural events occurred: earthquakes, solar eclipses, and floods. In the fourth year, the young emperor, aware he was not the Queen's biological son, complained and was imprisoned. The Empress Dowager replaced him with Liu Hong, King of Hengshan. In the fifth year, Wei Tuo, King of Nanyue, declared himself emperor. In the sixth year, there was a general amnesty and construction at Changling. The Xiongnu invaded in the seventh year, and several kings died or were imprisoned. In the eighth year, Empress Lu died in Weiyang Palace.
